about_section.title: Forensic engineering and courtroom experience
about_section.lede: A technical practice led by a chartered civil engineer (ECCAT No. 16448), court-appointed expert witness registered with the Ministry of Justice and insurance expert (IRD). Seventeen years of forensic engineering experience, with over 340 court ratifications.
about_section.quote: "My job is to document the cause in a way that the judge can verify it independently."

items.q: How much does an expert report cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope and complexity. After a free initial consultation you will receive a fixed written quote before any work begins.

items.q: Does the report work in court or only with my insurer?
items.a: Both. Every report is drafted under the Spanish Civil Procedure Act and applicable technical standards, with the traceability required for judicial ratification.

items.q: How long does it take from first contact?
items.a: Between two and four weeks from inspection, depending on the case. Deadlines are always agreed in writing beforehand.
Yes. The firm is based in Barcelona but we operate throughout Spain, attending in person for inspections and court appearances.
